scope: prediction-tab fields in the current response; detailed analysis history is fixed to 1y
nullable_fields: buy_price.*_bands[].steps[].reach_probability_pct (null only if the volatility model itself is unavailable)

data_quality.status: 정상 | 데이터 부족 | 오래된 데이터 | 일부 데이터 수집 실패
data_quality.volume_basis: live_bar | completed_bar; completed_bar while the last daily bar is still forming during the regular session (volume ratios then use the last confirmed bar)

price_anchor.anchor_id: 16-character SHA-256 prefix identifying the quote snapshot
price_anchor.current_price: number; canonical price shared by all prediction sections
price_anchor.mixed_time_basis: boolean; true when the quote and confirmed indicator bar use different time bases

mismatches: response field path corrected to the canonical current price

direction_probability.prob_up: number; displayed 22-session rise probability, calibrated to realised frequency (market base rate +/- a near-zero tilt) when probability_calibration.applied
direction_probability.prob_up_raw: number; rule-score based probability before calibration (signal score, not a verified probability)
direction_probability.probability_calibration: {applied, method, slope, base_rate_pct, horizon_sessions, fitted_period, fitted_rows, note}; applied=false (identity) when models/probability_calibration.json is missing or broken

regime_layers.index_structure: {key BULL|BEAR|NEUTRAL, label, value, basis, tone, used_for}; index close vs 60/120-day averages (also exposed as market_regime)
regime_layers.long_regime: {key BULLISH|BEARISH|SIDEWAYS, label, value, basis, tone, used_for} | null; benchmark 200-day average + ADX + VIX, only when a benchmark is supplied
regime_layers.stock_trend: {key, label, value, basis, tone, used_for} | null; the stock's own ADX/DI when no benchmark is supplied (not a market regime)
regime_layers.note: string | null; explains that the layers can disagree on the same day

aggressive_bands.is_available: always true: the 1st (aggressive_bands) and 2nd (recommended_bands) entry families are always returned with 3 bands x 5 steps
aggressive_bands.evidence_level: structure (2+ independent price sources overlap the range) | indicator (one source) | volatility (no chart source; range sized by ATR and touch probability)
evidence_sources: Korean source names inside the band
aggressive_bands.nearest_reference: {label, price, gap_pct} | null; closest chart level to the band centre
aggressive_bands.reach_probability_range_pct: [min of probability_low_pct, max of probability_high_pct] | null

steps.reach_probability_pct: number; chance the low touches the step price within 30 sessions, zero-drift volatility model
steps.probability_low_pct: number; same model with sigma x0.800 (25th percentile of forward/predicted volatility; x0.836 when STOCKORACLE_VOL_LONG_RUN_WEIGHT=0)
steps.probability_high_pct: number; same model with sigma x1.200 (75th percentile; x1.268 when STOCKORACLE_VOL_LONG_RUN_WEIGHT=0)
steps.days_min: number; 25th percentile of the first-touch day given a touch within 30 sessions (1..30)

buy_price.recommended_bands: same band structure, always strictly below every aggressive band

price_structure.method: OHLCV, moving-average, Bollinger, swing-low and volume-price candidate clustering
price_structure.ready: boolean; chart-structure completeness only, it no longer hides prices
price_structure.deep_structure_ready: boolean; a separate support cluster exists below the 1st-entry family
price_structure.evidence_summary: {aggressive|recommended: {structure, indicator, volatility}} band counts per evidence level
price_structure.ordering_relaxed: {aggressive, recommended}: true only when the A>B>C step ordering could not be restored above the 10% price floor
price_structure.clusters: ordered support clusters with center, range, score, source_count, sources and labels

risk_scenarios.provisional: boolean, optional; true when fewer than 20 valid daily closes

target_price.reach_probability: number; chance of touching min_price within horizon_days under the zero-drift volatility model, recomputed after any range adjustment
target_price.reach_probability_basis: touch_probability | heuristic_fallback (only when volatility is unavailable)

decision.label: string
decision.confidence: number; signal agreement, not a calibrated rise probability

entry_plan.reference_price: number; signal-bar close used as the first-buy reference

scenarios.probability: number; relative scenario weight, not a calibrated outcome probability

forecast.base_price: number | absent when unavailable; statistical forecast base, not a second current-price source
